To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the implementation of the Citizenship curriculum is not without problems; (2) citizenship education can be made more relevant, more effective, and more enjoyable if it is underpinned by principles of experiental and service learning; (3) there is a need for a national citizenship service; (4) there is a strong link between the quality of citizenship education in schools and political participation among young adults.
